text:
Pittsburgh arrives winless in four (0-3-1) after a 6-2 home loss to Boston on Wednesday, and it is playing without Bryan Rust, Elmer Soderblom and Trevor van Riemsdyk. Tommy Novak has taken Rust's spot beside Sidney Crosby and Rickard Rakell, up to 18:10 a night from 14:05. Los Angeles is coming off a 7-2 win over San Jose in which Adrian Kempe scored three, though Mats Zuccarello is still out. Artemi Panarin has taken his spot beside Haula and Laferriere.

The chances are close. Our model has the Kings at 3.19 expected goals tonight to Pittsburgh's 3.09, and at five on five the teams are 50% and 52% in share of expected goals. The gap is on special teams: LAK's power play generates 0.84 expected goals a game to PIT's 0.46, and the Kings take 4.2 penalties a game, which keeps handing the other side power plays. In net, projected starter Sergei Murashov (PIT) is at -3.9 goals saved above expected this season, meaning he has allowed about four more goals than an average goalie would on those shots. Projected starter Darcy Kuemper (LAK) is at -3.1, and -6.8 last season.

Kempe is our top goal pick at 40%, and Panarin is 77% for a point. We'd also watch Quinton Byfield, one of our under-the-radar picks: he's 53% for a point, above his season pace of 44%, with his ice time up and his line creating chances. For Pittsburgh, Rakell leads at 31% to score, and Crosby is 57% for a point.
